params:

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = NA)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
# get the procedure name
procedure <- getDesign(params$Seq)

proc <- substr(procedure, 1, 2)

#get the common parameters
n <- params$Seq@N
k <- params$Seq@K
ratio <- params$Seq@ratio
seed <- params$Seq@seed
groups <- params$Seq@groups

#possible Designs:
  #BSD -> "BSD(x)"
  #CR -> "CR"
  #EBC -> "EBC(x)"
  #MAX -> "MP"
  #PBD -> "PBR(x)"
  #RPBD -> "RPBR(x)"
  #TBD -> "TBD(x)"
  #URN -> "UD(x,x)"

#get procedure specific parameters
switch(proc,
      'BS'= mti <- params$Seq@mti,
      'CR'= NULL,
      'EB'= p <- params$Seq@p,
      'MP'= mti <- params$Seq@mti,
      'PB'= bc <- params$Seq@bc,
      'RP'= {rb <- params$Seq@rb
            fb <-params$Seq@filledBlock},
      'TB'= bc <- params$Seq@bc,
      'UD'= {ini <- params$Seq@ini
             add <- params$Seq@add},
      'RA'= NULL,
      'RT'= {rb <- params$Seq@rb
            fb <-params$Seq@filledBlock}
      )




```

# Randomization Sequence:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat(getRandList(params$Seq))
```
# Visualization of randomization sequence:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
if (k == 2){
plot(0:length(params$Seq@M), cumsum(c(0,2*params$Seq@M-1)), type = "b", 
         xlab = "Patients", ylab ="Treatment assignment")
} else {
  cat("The visualization of the randomization sequence is not available for more than 2 arms")
}

```

# Code

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Genrate report depending on the procedure
ratstr <- ''
for (l in ratio){
  ratstr <- paste(ratstr, l, sep = ',')  
}
grstr <- ''
for (g in groups){
  temp = paste('\'',g,'\'', sep = '')
  grstr <- paste(grstr, temp, sep = ',')  
}

switch(proc,
      'BS'= cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence: \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(bsdPar(',n,',',mti,', groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')), 1, ', seed,')') ,
      'CR'= {cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence:
                \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(crPar(',n,',',k,', ratio = c(',sub('.','',ratstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')')} ,
      'EB'= cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence: \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(ebcPar(',n,',',p,', groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')') ,
      'MP'= {cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence: \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(mpPar(',n,',',mti,', ratio = c(',sub('.','',ratstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')')} ,
      'PB'= { bcstr <- ''
              for (l in bc){
                bcstr <- paste(bcstr, l, sep = ',')  
              }
              cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence:
                \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(pbrPar(c(',sub('.','',bcstr),'), ratio = c(',sub('.','',ratstr),'), c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')')} ,
      'RP'= { rbstr <- ''
              for (l in rb){
                rbstr <- paste(rbstr, l, sep = ',')  
              }
              cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence:
                \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(rpbrPar(',n,',c(',sub('.','',rbstr),'),',k,', ratio = c(',sub('.','',ratstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),'), filledBlock =',fb,'),1 ,', seed,')')} ,
      'TB'= { bcstr <- ''
              for (l in bc){
                bcstr <- paste(bcstr, l, sep = ',')  
              }
              cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence:
                \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(tbdPar(c(',sub('.','',bcstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')')}, 
      'UD'= cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence: \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(udPar(',n,',',ini,',',add,' groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')'),
      
      'RA'= cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence: \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(rarPar(',n,',',k,', ratio = c(',sub('.','',ratstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),')),1 ,', seed,')'),
      'RT' ={ rbstr <- ''
              for (l in rb){
                rbstr <- paste(rbstr, l, sep = ',')  
              }
              cat('The following code was used to generate the randomization sequence:
                \n library(randomizeR) \n',
                  'genSeq(rtbdPar(',n,',c(',sub('.','',rbstr),'), groups = c(',sub('.','',grstr),'), filledBlock =',fb,'),1 ,', seed,')')
        
      }
      )


```
